title: The Jars to Return to the Grocer
youtube_title: The Jars to Return to the Grocer | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small useful favor can be louder than a big speech.
summary: At a market lane of baskets, jars, and flower pots, an empty jars to return to the grocer is awkward for one person. Cosima notices Grandma Nia struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
